hr.title: HR Management
bullets: Digital Employee Profiles: Manage personal information, National IDs (CMND/CCCD), and emergency contacts.
Employment Lifecycle Tracking: Seamlessly monitor employee status from probation to official placement and offboarding procedures.
Personnel Transitions: Quickly update the history of promotions, department transfers, and role changes.
Rewards & Disciplinary Actions: Manage internal corporate decisions complete with official document reference numbers.
Multi-Tier Salary Approvals: Standardize a closed-loop approval workflow spanning from HR to the Board of Directors.
Periodic Salary Adjustments: Configure and execute scheduled, company-wide income adjustment cycles.
Tax Dependents & Deductions: Register dependents with automated data sync to optimize Personal Income Tax (PIT) calculations.

contract.title: Labor Contracts
bullets: Dynamic Contract Templates: Auto-fill variable placeholders directly from employee profiles (Name, salary, department, role).
5 Standard Contract Types: Fully support Probation, Fixed-term, Indefinite-term, Seasonal, and Project-based contracts.
Internal E-Signing Workflow: Standardize a seamless digital signature lifecycle: Draft → Sign → Approve → Active.
Contract Addendums: Easily create, issue, and manage addendums for any contract modifications or amendments.
Comprehensive Audit Logs: Track and log every single modification and status update for absolute transparency.
Professional PDF Export: Generate and export fully formatted, presentation-ready PDF contracts with a single click.

timekeeping.title: Time & Attendance
bullets: Multi-Method Check-In/Out: Support flexible attendance tracking via GPS geofencing, office Wi-Fi, IP white-listing, facial recognition, fingerprints, RFID cards, or a mobile app.
Flexible Shift Creation: Easily configure any shift type, including morning, afternoon, night, or fully customized working hours.
Shift Planning & Scheduling: Streamline workforce scheduling by assigning and deploying shifts to employees on a weekly or monthly basis.
Shift Swapping Workflows: Allow employees to submit shift-swap requests with an automated online approval flow for managers.
Unified Timesheets: Generate and aggregate real-time timesheets filtered by specific departments, stores, or branches.
Automated Holiday Handling: Built-in calendar for public holidays that automatically calculates special attendance rates and multipliers.
Overtime (OT) Management: Simplify the entire overtime lifecycle from request and multi-level approval to automated hours tracking.

payroll.title: Payroll & Income
bullets: Automated Payroll Runs: Automatically process and calculate precise salary payouts per payment period (monthly) based on timesheet data.
Statutory Insurance Compliance: Configure and auto-update mandatory insurance contribution rates (Social, Health, and Unemployment) in strict compliance with Vietnamese labor laws.
Progressive PIT & Deductions: Apply progressive Personal Income Tax (PIT) tax brackets and automatically factor in personal and dependent tax reliefs.
Flexible Allowances & Benefits: Easily configure custom allowances based on flat monthly rates, daily attendance, hourly calculations, or specific percentages.
Closed-Loop Payroll Workflow: Standardize secure payroll operations through clear stages: Draft → Calculate → Approve → Disburse → Lock Period.
Compensation History Tracking: Maintain a comprehensive chronological log of all salary increments and compensation adjustments for every employee.
Detailed Payslip Export: Generate and distribute itemized, presentation-ready digital payslips in secure PDF format.

notice.title: AZOERP announcement — free e-invoice and digital signature
notice.excerpt: Dear customers, in the context of Decree 70/2025/NĐ-CP taking effect on June 1, 2026...
notice.content:
Dear customers,

In the context of Decree 70/2025/NĐ-CP taking effect on June 1, 2026, AZOERP is pleased to announce fully free e-invoice and digital signature services for all customers on our platform.

Eligibility

  • All businesses on AZOERP Standard plan or above
  • New sign-ups during the promotion period
  • Household businesses needing digital transformation per the Decree

Benefits

  • 100% fee waiver for e-invoice issuance in the first year
  • Free business digital signature service
  • Free implementation and onboarding support

For details, please contact AZOERP's consulting team via hotline or email listed in the Contact section.

Best regards,
The AZOERP team

award.title: AZOERP ranked TOP 10 products & services of 2025 — Technology category
award.excerpt: On December 20, at the Vietnam Trusted Products & Services 2025 program hosted by Vietnam Economic Magazine...
award.content:
On December 20, at the Vietnam Trusted Products & Services 2025 program hosted by Vietnam Economic Magazine in partnership with VnEconomy, AZOERP was proudly named among the TOP 10 trusted products and services in the technology category.

The award was voted by

  • More than 20,000 consumers and businesses nationwide
  • Expert council of Vietnam Economic Magazine
  • Evaluation criteria including product quality, reliability, and market impact

What this means for AZOERP

This milestone recognizes AZOERP's efforts in digitally transforming Vietnam's HR industry. In 2025, AZOERP has served 500+ businesses with over 200,000 employees using the platform daily.

We sincerely thank all our customers, partners, and team members for trusting and walking this journey with us.
